sections.label: MSF study on homeless families
sections.summary: A 2014 MSF study found homeless families often faced divorce and financial difficulties, and many had sold flats to clear debts.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In 2014, MSF conducted a study on families in transitional housing to better understand the challenges and needs of homeless families.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The study found that these families often experienced occurrences, such as divorce and financial difficulties.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Many had sold their flats and spent their monies to clear debts or for other purposes prior to becoming homeless.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To help them regain housing stability, it is important for us to help them address their underlying issues, such as providing employment assistance and counselling to address marital and family issues.

sections.label: MSF support for homeless cases
sections.summary: MSF works with MND, HDB and community organisations to support homeless families, with cases falling from about 321 in 2013 to 296 last year.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: MSF is committed to working with the Ministry of National Development, the Housing and Development Board and community organisations to identify and provide support to homeless families and individuals.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In fact, over the last three years or so, we have seen the numbers falling slightly from about 321 cases in 2013 to 296 cases last year.
